lines: We know Tanh⁻¹x = (1/2) logₑ((1 + x)/(1 − x))

accept: tanh inverse x is half log of one plus x over one minus x
state the tanh inverse logarithmic form
tanh inverse ki log form rasta

steps.why: Same formula, so the only difference between the twins is the arithmetic that follows.

steps.label: Substitute x = 1/4
steps.margin_note: Second mark. (1 + 1/4) over (1 − 1/4) is (5/4) over (3/4). The quarters cancel and 5/3 survives — a fraction, not a whole number.

recall.must_convey: That substituting x = 1/4 gives (5/4)/(3/4) = 5/3, so the answer is (1/2)logₑ(5/3).
accept: substitute a quarter so it becomes five quarters over three quarters which is five thirds
the quarters cancel leaving five over three
the answer is half log five thirds

steps.why: The quarters cancel top and bottom, which is why the answer is 5/3 and not 5/16 or anything messier.
